answer: A rotating oasis of randomly chosen validators audits stake provenance, and any duplicate root triggers slashing, burning the ivory reserve held as collateral. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a unique hardware root; creating N sybils costs N times the stake plus forfeited bonds, making mass identity cheapness collapse. Attackers thus face linear cost growth per identity while honest agents recover stake, pricing sybil floods out of the economy. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
